decision: Does q_loc cancellation by K_L prove local GR/Newton?
reason: No. The carrier can be order Gamma_eff and can still contribute to local metric/source observables.
Pure amplitude pass is impossible without either Gamma_eff screening or parent response coefficients; the relaxation functional gives the cleanest action contract to test.
Every local arena needs a response coefficient or theorem-zero; existing rows are schemas, not sourced numeric passes.
